details.about: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform used by millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to ambitious startups, to accept payments, grow revenue and open new business opportunities. This full-stack role works on systems that handle billions of money movement requests, including Stripe's balance management platform and new fund accessibility platforms for enterprises and small businesses. Multiple positions are available.
duties: Scope, design, build and maintain APIs, services and large-scale systems that handle billions of money movement requests
Debug and solve critical production issues across services and levels of the stack
Build new features at scale with stakeholders while improving internal engineering standards, tooling and processes
Extend the balance management platform and build new fund accessibility platforms for enterprises and SMBs
Work across infrastructure and product teams to meet evolving user needs
needs: Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related field, plus 5 years of progressive post-baccalaureate software engineering experience
5 years with large-scale financial tracking systems
5 years with cloud-based services including gRPC, GraphQL, Docker/Kubernetes or AWS
5 years designing, developing and operating mission-critical gRPC services
5 years of software architecture and system design, debugging/troubleshooting, and API development and design
1 year designing, developing and operating public web APIs
details.benefits: Base salary $193,461 – $285,600 a year; any sales commissions or bonuses would be on top. Additional benefits may include equity, a company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses, a 401(k) plan, medical, dental and vision benefits and wellness stipends.
